title: Fujita's Global Generation and Very-Ampleness Conjecture
exact_target: Let $L$ be an ample line bundle on a complex manifold $X$. Is $K_X\otimes L^m$ globally generated for $m\geq\dim X+1$ and very ample for $m\geq\dim X+2$?
